description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_MultiLength, which validates 'multilength' attributes according to the HTML specification, handling integer, percentage, and relative '*' length values within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_MultiLength
